reviews.comment:
Estacion de servicio completa. Aunque haya fila avanza rapido porque hay muchas islas. Tiene una Full para tomar algo. Atencion: algo que poca gente sabe es que en el edificio del ACA (mismo edificio) hay un museo del automovil maravilloso y gratuiti. Si van a cargar ahi, sobre todo con chicos, val la pena bajar 5 minutos.

(Translated by Google)
Full service station. Even if there's a line, it moves quickly because there are many pumps. There's a Full convenience store where you can get something to eat or drink. Note: something few people know is that in the ACA building (same building) there's a wonderful and free automobile museum. If you're going to fill up there, especially with kids, it's worth going down for 5 minutes.
